title: A Theory of Online Learning with Autoregressive Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2605.06819v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Autoregressive generation lies at the heart of the mechanism of large language models. It can be viewed as the repeated application of a next-token generator: starting from an input string (prompt), the generator is applied for $M$ steps, and the last generated token is taken as the final output. [Joshi et al., 2025] proposed a PAC model for studying the learnability of the input-output maps arising from this process. We develop an online analogue of this framework, focusing on the mistake bound of learning the final output induced by an unknown next-token generator.   We distinguish between two forms of feedback. In the End-to-End model, after each round the learner observes only the final token produced after $M$ autoregressive steps. In the Chain-of-Thought model, the learner is additionally shown the entire $M$-step trajectory. translated_title: 自回归思维链推理的在线学习理论
translated_abstract: 自回归生成是大语言模型机制的核心。它可以被视为一个“下一个词元生成器”的重复应用：从输入字符串（提示）开始，该生成器被应用 M 步，最后生成的词元作为最终输出。Joshi 等人（2025）提出了一个 PAC 模型来研究由这一过程产生的输入输出映射的可学习性。我们发展了这一框架的在线学习版本，专注于学习由未知的下一个词元生成器所诱导的最终输出的错误边界。我们区分了两种反馈形式：在端到端模型中，每一轮之后学习器只能观察到经过 M 步自回归后产生的最终词元；而在思维链模型中，学习器还能看到完整的 M 步推理轨迹。我们的目标是理解最优错误边界如何依赖于生成步数 M，以及……
tldr: 本文建立了自回归思维链推理的在线学习理论框架，比较了端到端反馈与思维链反馈两种模式下，学习未知下一个词元生成器所诱导输出的最优错误边界如何随生成步数 M 变化。
en_tdlr: This paper develops an online learning theory of autoregressive chain-of-thought reasoning, characterizing how the optimal mistake bound for learning outputs from an unknown next-token generator depends on the generation horizon M under End-to-End versus Chain-of-Thought feedback models.
